text:
Nora Patel: Hi folks, happy to join! Two quick access snags: 1) my Okta account shows active but I can't finish passkey enrollment (error says 'invalid session'). 2) 1Password invite link bounced with 'link not found'. Who should I ping?

Ethan (IT): welcome Nora! For 1Password ping People Ops (Rosa). For the passkey error can you say which browser and device? Also any corporate aliases?

Nora Patel: macOS Sonoma, using Chrome 119. No other aliases that I know of; email used was nora.p@redwood.dev.

Rosa (People Ops): hey Nora  sorry about the 1Password hiccup, looks like your initial invite expired. I'll revoke and send a fresh seat to nora.p@redwood.dev right now.

Nora Patel: thanks Rosa.

Dylan M: small note: sometimes Chrome profile cookie for a personal google account will interfere with Okta session. Try a private window.

Nora Patel: tried private window and cleared site data, same 'invalid session' during passkey creation after I pick a device. No phone push showed up either.

Ethan (IT): ok I'm checking Okta logs. I see an authentication attempt then a session validation failure referencing a stale session id. I'm going to force-refresh your SSO session and push a new device-trust packet.

IT Support Bot: Ticket #INC-2157 created: "Nora P - Okta passkey invalid session + 1Password invite". Assigned to Ethan (IT). Priority: P2.

Rosa (People Ops): 1Password invite resent to nora.p@redwood.dev. If you don't see it, check Spam/Promotions and let me know.

Nora Patel: got the 1Password invite and confirmed MFA setup. Thanks!

Ethan (IT): I cleared the stale session and pushed a new enrollment packet. Try passkey enrollment now and accept the device prompt on your phone. If it still fails, paste the exact popup text.

Nora Patel: trying now... enrollment succeeded! device trust shows active. Also quick follow-up: I can't clone a private repo yet (403). Who adds GitHub team membership?

Marc L: welcome Nora :tada: ping me with the repo name(s). I'll add you to the right org team once People Ops confirms your corporate email match.

Nora Patel: awesome, repo is infra/config. I'll DM you. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround :pray:

Ethan (IT): glad it's sorted. Posting resolution steps in the onboarding doc so future new-hires see the checklist (clear cookies, incognito test, confirm alias, request fresh 1Password seat).

Nora Patel: love that, appreciate the proactive doc update.
